milestones.title: Calendar milestones

start.title: Start the {{year}} edition?
start.description: It becomes the current edition and FiringChiefs will see it. Orders stay closed until you open them.

openOrders.title: Open the {{year}} orders?
openOrders.description: FiringChiefs will be able to prepare and edit their comparsas' orders.

closeOrders.title: Close the {{year}} orders?
closeOrders.description: Orders become read-only for FiringChiefs. You can open them again for corrections.

closeEdition.title: Close the {{year}} edition?
closeEdition.description: It is no longer the current edition and is kept as history. FiringChiefs will still see it.

backToDraft.title: Prepare the {{year}} edition again?
backToDraft.description: It is no longer the current edition and FiringChiefs will stop seeing it.

reopen.title: Reopen the {{year}} edition?
reopen.description: It becomes the current edition again, with orders closed.

delete.title: Delete the {{year}} edition?
delete.description: Its rental models and milestones are deleted too. This cannot be undone.
